scope: Production local Next apps with synthetic Auth/PostgREST contracts. SQL covers privilege constraints separately; no hosted MFA/RLS/concurrency proof.
checks: Admin draft renders without live activation or implicit preview approval
Double submit produces one version and clears dirty state
Saved check does not bypass explicit review checkbox
Explicit review changes preview pointer with disabled runtime message
Version history preserves old rules and reason/actor evidence
Cancel dirty navigation preserves admin edits
Admin stale conflict is visible and retains unsaved draft
Admin mobile light layout has no horizontal page overflow
Site preferences save and reload through scoped API
Context preview renders approved fact citations without platform instructions or model answer
Dirty preferences disable preview and cancel signout protects form
Viewer form is read-only but scoped preview remains available
Customer mobile light layout wraps content and citations
Ungrant admin receives unavailable page and API403
Public host does not expose admin configuration
